points.title: Neverwinter
points.clue: A great city on the Sword Coast, where Gundren hired the party for the journey south.
points.note: Starting point. This map is an approximate campaign overview, not a measured travel map.

points.title: Thundertree
points.clue: Ruins lie at the edge of Neverwinter Wood.
points.note: Chapter 3 optional branch. Reidoth can help locate Cragmaw Castle. Do not reveal the dragon or cultists on the map.

points.title: Agatha’s lair
points.clue: An old path leaves the ruined village and winds into the woods.
points.note: Sister Garaele’s optional lead. Reveal the exact destination only when the party learns it.

points.title: Conyberry
points.clue: The eastern trail reaches an abandoned village.
points.note: Chapter 3 optional branch; Agatha’s trail begins nearby.

points.title: Cragmaw Castle
points.clue: An old stronghold stands somewhere within the forest.
points.note: DM continuity: Redbrands abducted Gundren and delivered him here. The party has not learned this. Reveal only after a credible lead.

points.title: Old Owl Well
points.clue: Ancient stones rise from the eastern hills.
points.note: Daran Edermath’s optional lead. Hamun Kost and the undead remain secret.

points.title: Wyvern Tor
points.clue: A rocky hill overlooks the southern wilds.
points.note: Optional orc threat from the Townmaster’s Hall notice. Do not reveal occupants until discovered.

points.title: Triboar Trail ambush
points.clue: Here the party found Gundren’s horses and fought goblins on the road.
points.note: Session 1 opening. The party followed the goblin trail to Cragmaw Hideout.

points.title: Cragmaw Hideout
points.clue: The party followed a goblin trail to this cave and rescued Sildar.
points.note: Session 1 complete: Klarg dead, Yeemik left in charge. Gundren’s destination was not learned.

points.title: Phandalin
points.clue: A frontier mining town at the end of the supply road. The party has reached Barthen’s Provisions.
points.note: Current campaign hub. Open the Phandalin town map for shops, NPCs, and local leads.

points.title: Tresendar Manor ruins
points.clue: A ruined manor watches over Phandalin from a low hill.
points.note: The ruins are visible from town. Redbrand hideout entrances and occupants stay private until discovered.

points.title: Wave Echo Cave
points.clue: A hidden cave lies somewhere in the Sword Mountains.
points.note: Do not reveal the point or location until Gundren’s map, testimony, or another credible discovery gives the party its position. Chapter 4.

points.title: Barthen’s Provisions
points.clue: A busy supply shop stands beside the road into town.
points.note: The party begins Session 2 here. Delivery and payment only happen if played.

points.title: Stonehill Inn
points.clue: Warm light and voices come from the largest inn near the green.
points.note: Rumors and Sildar’s lodging; Lost Mine pp. 15–16.

points.title: Townmaster’s Hall
points.clue: A modest public hall sits on the south side of the green.
points.note: Harbin Wester; town notices and orc reward.

points.title: Lionshield Coster
points.clue: A sturdy trading post displays a blue lion shield.
points.note: Linene Graywind; stolen goods from Cragmaw Hideout.

points.title: Miner’s Exchange
points.clue: Prospectors come and go with pouches of ore and dust.
points.note: Halia Thornton; do not announce her private goals.

points.title: Shrine of Luck
points.clue: A small shrine stands near the road and the town green.
points.note: Sister Garaele; Agatha lead if offered.

points.title: Sleeping Giant
points.clue: The tap house has a rougher crowd than the inn.
points.note: Redbrand pressure can arise here; do not place foes until the scene warrants it.

points.title: Alderleaf Farm
points.clue: Fields and a farmhouse lie along the edge of town.
points.note: Qelline and Carp; allow clues to emerge through play.

points.title: Edermath Orchard
points.clue: Rows of fruit trees lead to a cottage on the west side.
points.note: Daran Edermath; Old Owl Well lead.

points.title: Tresendar Manor ruins
points.clue: A ruined manor overlooks the settlement from a low hill.
points.note: The visible ruins are public. The Redbrand entrance and tunnel remain private.

points.title: Hillside tunnel
points.clue: A narrow opening cuts into the slope below the manor.
points.note: Reveal only after the party finds this entrance.

points.title: Ruined village green
points.clue: Grass and saplings have overtaken the old center of Conyberry.
points.note: Custom orientation landmark; the published settlement is abandoned.

points.title: Westward ruins
points.clue: Only foundations remain among the trees.
points.note: Custom orientation landmark. Do not imply a keyed encounter.

points.title: Broken stone building
points.clue: A roofless stone building faces the old road.
points.note: Custom orientation landmark. Let players describe their search.

points.title: Old riverside building
points.clue: A large ruin stands near the watercourse.
points.note: Custom orientation landmark, not a published room key.

points.title: Forest trail
points.clue: A narrow path disappears into the western woods.
points.note: Reveal when the party follows the Agatha lead or discovers the path.

points.title: Western cottages
points.clue: Broken cottages stand among ash-dusted trees.
points.note: Areas 1–2. Keep occupants and hazards private.

points.title: Old inn
points.clue: A weathered sign hangs above the remains of an inn.
points.note: Area 3, Brown Horse. Reveal only what is visible.

points.title: Boarded cottage
points.clue: This cottage is in better repair than the surrounding ruins.
points.note: Area 4, Druid’s Watch. Reidoth is not on the public marker.

points.title: Ruined store
points.clue: Webs and broken beams cover a former shop.
points.note: Area 6. Do not reveal spiders before seen.

points.title: Old tower
points.clue: A round tower rises above the overgrown settlement.
points.note: Area 7. Do not reveal Venomfang before seen.

points.title: Old smithy
points.clue: A ruined forge sits beside the eastern track.
points.note: Area 8.

points.title: Herbalist’s shop
points.clue: A small shop is almost swallowed by vines.
points.note: Area 9.

points.title: Town square
points.clue: A worn statue stands at the meeting of the old paths.
points.note: Area 10.

points.title: Old garrison
points.clue: Heavy stone walls still outline a guard post.
points.note: Area 11.

points.title: Eastern cottage
points.clue: A cottage stands at the far edge of the ruins.
points.note: Area 13. Do not identify the cultists until discovered.

points.title: The Yawning Portal
points.clue: The famous inn is a gathering place for adventurers in Castle Ward.
points.note: Campaign home base. The well descends to Undermountain.

points.title: Castle Waterdeep
points.clue: The city’s fortress dominates the high ground above the harbor.
points.note: Public landmark; city map is a schematic, not a street-accurate plan.

points.title: Deepwater Harbor
points.clue: Ships crowd the quays beside the Dock Ward.
points.note: Public landmark.

points.title: City of the Dead
points.clue: Gardens and memorials fill the walled cemetery.
points.note: Public landmark.

points.title: North Gate
points.clue: The northern road enters the city through its great wall.
points.note: Public landmark.

points.title: Second Margin bookshop
points.clue: A bookshop awaits investigation in Castle Ward.
points.note: Custom Echo Below location. Reveal only after the party learns of it.

points.title: Lantern House
points.clue: A familiar refuge lies among the streets of the Southern Ward.
points.note: Custom hub location. Reveal when introduced.
